sample_kind: redacted source sheets of one building from the evaluation set
matching_metrics: ../metrics/  (per-cell metrics for this building share the same project_id prefix as the GT file)
verification_workflow: 1. Inspect sheet_NN_*.png to see the input modality.
2. Cross-reference each sheet to the floor entries in the released GT file under ../gt/ (axes, columns, beams).
3. Optionally: run your own agent on these sheets, then evaluate against the GT with ../../code/eval/evaluate.py, and compare the resulting metric against the matching metrics JSON in ../metrics/.
license_note: These sheets are released under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (research-only, no derivatives) per ../../LICENSE.
rationale_for_partial_release: All buildings in the evaluation set are drawings of real building projects. Most are subject to redistribution restrictions (engineering-design IP, client confidentiality, third-party rights). This sample is the one building for which we have unambiguous redistribution rights under research-only terms. See ../../DATASHEET.md § 3 and § 6 for the full discussion.
